query:
SELECT m.id, m.sponsorId, m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot, m.status, a.firstName, a.lastName, a.company, s.companyName
FROM meetings m
JOIN attendees a ON m.attendeeId = a.id
JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE (a.firstName LIKE '%Oliver%' AND a.lastName LIKE '%Brown%')
   OR (a.firstName LIKE '%Oliver%' AND s.companyName LIKE '%Wilson%')
ORDER BY m.id;
